sentences.en: The faulty left-hand engine failed catastrophically as the aircraft approached the airport.

sentences.en: By the time we had to sell, prices had fallen catastrophically.

sentences.en: The user interface utilized frames, and one of the sanity-checks performed by my display program could fail catastrophically if another program modified the database while it was running.

sentences.en: Now a newcomer has entered the game and the result is catastrophically interesting.

sentences.en: But Panama was all jungle , torrential rain , malaria and yellow fever , and the French failed catastrophically.
